round_1_result.finding: a first close below zone_l was too sensitive: it reduced severe losses but prematurely exited many eventual target winners
round_1_result.action: R1 and R2 from round 1 are not retained

new_visual_evidence.matched_review: same-date eventual winners and severe losers plus round-1 false-negative winners
new_visual_evidence.observation_1: eventual winners often retest or close below zone_l but more often preserve the full signal recovery candle low
new_visual_evidence.observation_2: severe losers more often invalidate the full signal recovery candle and continue lower
new_visual_evidence.observation_3: 76.6% of baseline target hits occurred within 10 holding sessions across 2014-2020

frozen_rules.definition: after entry and before target, first legal daily close strictly below the already-known signal candle low arms exit at next legal sellable open
frozen_rules.target_priority: a legal intraday touch of frozen zone_u on the same day is filled before the close-based exit can be known

frozen_rules.definition: if frozen zone_u has not been reached by calendar index entry_idx+10, arm exit at next legal sellable open
frozen_rules.economic_claim: the setup is a repricing/re-entry event; failure to complete within the empirically visible fast phase means the expected mechanism did not arrive

user_gate: at least 50 completed signals in every 2014-2020 year and mean net event return above 4% in every year
